$comment: Noor tool contract. Every tool: strict input schema, fixed output shape, an explicit authz rule the runner enforces before the query, and a 'never' list the model is told. No tool accepts SQL, filter strings, table names, or tenant ids the model invented.

enum: Double layer splint - outer hard, inner soft

reason_code.description: Codes map 1:1 to REMAKE_REASONS in src/Remake.jsx plus 'other'

patient_ref.description: The clinic's own patient reference (patient_id). Name and phone are omitted unless caller is the case's clinic and requested them.

tools.name: get_case
tools.description: Fetch one case the caller is authorised to see, redacted for the model. Use before any note, flag, update or escalation. NEVER use to look up a case for a different clinic or lab; if RLS returns nothing, report 'not visible or does not exist' without distinguishing.
tools.authz: Runs as the caller (JWT → RLS). Scheduled runs: service role scoped by lab_id of the current job.

include_patient.description: Only honoured when caller belongs to the case's clinic.

tools.name: list_cases
tools.description: List cases the caller can see, filtered and paginated. Use for 'what is outstanding / due / late / awaiting'. NEVER pass a clinic_id or lab_id the caller did not receive from a tool result; NEVER use to enumerate other tenants.
tools.authz: Runs as the caller (JWT → RLS). Tenant filters are validated against the caller's memberships before the query.

search.description: Substring of case id or patient_ref only.

tools.name: validate_prescription
tools.description: Deterministic completeness and consistency check of a prescription. Pure code, no model. Checks: teeth present and consistent with notation; category present; material present where the category has materials; shade guide and shade present for shaded restorations (or 'Shade by Lab'); at least one scan or the relevant impression items included; need_by_date present and not before promise_date; notes that contradict structured fields (tooth numbers, shade, material named in notes but different in fields). NEVER use to 'approve' a case or to alter it.
tools.authz: Service role read of the single case identified by the trigger.

tools.name: request_clarification
tools.description: Record ONE question to the submitting dentist and put the case in 'needs clarification'. Exactly one open clarification per case; a second call while one is open fails. The question must name the case id and the specific item. NEVER use for anything other than an intake issue returned by validate_prescription; NEVER use to ask the lab.
tools.authz: Service role; precondition: case has no open clarification and stage is STILL_AT_CLINIC or PICKED_UP_BY_LAB.
tools.side_effects: insert case_clarifications; insert case_flags(needs_clarification, visible_to=both); templated email to clinic in clinics.language

tools.name: get_turnaround_benchmark
tools.description: Return the lab's benchmark for a restoration type and the per-stage expectations for a case (from labs.procedure_tats / labs.tat and the G5 defaults). NEVER estimate a benchmark yourself; if none exists the tool says so.
tools.authz: Runs as the caller; lab_id must be the case's lab.

tools.name: flag_case_risk
tools.description: Create or update a risk flag on a case with a reason, and choose who sees it. The verdict (at_risk / overdue / stale) comes from the watcher job; the model only supplies wording. NEVER flag from a hunch; NEVER make an overdue flag clinic-visible before the watcher marks it confirmed.
tools.authz: Service role; scoped by the job's lab_id or assertCanAct for user-triggered runs.

tools.name: send_status_update
tools.description: Send a templated, localized stage update to the case's clinic. The body is rendered by a fixed template from get_case data; the model passes only ids. NEVER pass free text; NEVER send to any address; NEVER send twice for the same stage transition.
tools.authz: Service role; precondition: an idempotency key (case_id, from_stage, to_stage) has not been used.
tools.side_effects: email via Resend to clinics.email; record resend_id on the run

tools.name: record_remake_reason
tools.description: Attach a structured reason to a remake (a case_rounds row of kind=remake, or cases.remake). Maps free text to reason_class + reason_code; keeps the original text. NEVER approve, reject, price or cost a remake; NEVER change the round's status.
tools.authz: Service role; assertCanAct: the caller (or trigger) belongs to the case's lab or clinic.

round_id.description: Omit for the case-level cases.remake slot.

tools.name: get_remake_patterns
tools.description: Aggregated remake counts by clinic×lab×reason_code over a period, with the lab's median for comparison. Returns only patterns above the configured thresholds. Pure code. NEVER returns patient data or individual case ids; NEVER use for a clinic other than the job's lab's own clinics.
tools.authz: Service role scoped to one lab_id.

tools.name: compose_daily_brief
tools.description: Return the four brief sections for one lab for today in its timezone: due today, overdue, awaiting clarification, needs a decision (open escalations, open remake rounds, cancellation requests). Pure code; the model only orders and trims. NEVER add items not returned; NEVER send.

tools.name: escalate_to_human
tools.description: Create an escalation for the named manager of the case's lab (or clinic) with a structured context log, and email them. Use for disputes, complaints, clinical questions, repeated failed clarifications, stale cases, tool failures, or when the user asks for a person. NEVER use to send a message to the other party; NEVER include patient name or phone in the log.
tools.authz: Service role; manager resolved by the G6 rule server-side; caller identity recorded.
tools.side_effects: insert escalations; email to manager; insert case_notes 'Noor: escalated (ref)' when a case is involved

tools.name: add_case_note
tools.description: Append a short factual note to a case as author 'Noor'. Notes record actions or facts ('Noor: clarification requested for shade on 24'), never opinions or advice. NEVER note patient data; NEVER use as a substitute for a tool that exists (e.g. do not 'note' a fee change).
tools.authz: Service role; assertCanAct: trigger or caller belongs to the case's lab or clinic.
